method: For each selected completed analysis snapshot, parse the final explicit Python tool-call code block and its tool result. Count returned action rows and match their cumulative action_num range back to exact event rows. These are tool-call boundaries, not analysis-step groupings.

counterfactual_for_confirmed_calls_only.score_effect: NOT MEASURED; later model calls could replan and issue different actions

limitations: Only three confirmed calls are quantified here; this is not a score counterfactual.

C2-088 B-v3's scorecard had integration_valid=false due an unsupported boundary-only label and gameplay_valid=false due runtime overrun; any C2-089 score must retain those comparator/runtime cautions until resolved.
No causal performance gain is established.
decision: The exact trace now confirms the action-cap treatment targets real multi-action Python snippets (including 37 actions in one call), so a private normal run is experimentally justified after the scorecard compatibility gate is handled. Do not call it an improvement or use competition quota.
